ranking_metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all releases
uncertainty: Pilot cell: two Java paths verified, netty-codec-dns and dnsjava, ranked by deps.dev direct dependents summed over releases (a weak signal). Netty leaves A/AAAA as raw records (the harness formats the decoded bytes) and its DnsQuery has no AA/TC/RA/RCODE. pcap4j and MiniDNS remain leads; vert.x is excluded as a network client over Netty's codec. Each verified path parses the two valid controls (a query and a response with compressed CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers) to the hand-written oracle summary, has library source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback that differs between the controls. Two valid controls do not establish EDNS0, DNSSEC, TXT, authority/additional or malformed-input behaviour. Package-level adoption metrics include non-DNS use; the remaining leads are unverified, and the cell is not a definitive top ten.
selection: Four control-verified Java DNS path(s), ranked by deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all releases: netty-codec-dns 4.2.21.Final (1,038), dnsjava 3.7.1 (888), pcap4j-core 1.8.2 (210), minidns-core 1.1.3 (32).
